description: This file defines the in-memory implementation of the ItemManagement interface for handling TodoItem objects. It uses thread-safe collections and atomic operations to manage a list of TodoItems, supporting add, update, and retrieval operations with concurrency considerations.

classes.name: TodoItemManagementInMemory
classes.description: An in-memory thread-safe implementation of the ItemManagement interface for managing TodoItems in a demo application.

methods.name: getTodoItems
methods.description: Returns the current list of TodoItems.

methods.name: setTodoItems
methods.description: Sets the internal list of TodoItems, optionally updating the id generator to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: addTodoItem
methods.description: Adds a new TodoItem to the list, assigning a unique id if necessary, all within a synchronized block for thread safety.

methods.name: updateTodoItem
methods.description: Updates a list of TodoItems, marking them as complete and replacing existing items by id.

methods.name: findIndexByIdLocked
methods.description: Finds the index of a TodoItem in the list by id, assuming the caller holds the lock.

methods.name: findMaxIdLocked
methods.description: Computes the maximum id present in the list, assuming the caller holds the lock.
